notes.title: Update and Development Cancellation (indefinite freeze) Notice
notes.notes:
・Fixed a bug that prevented fleets from returning from outside the map area.
・Externalization of character naming convention file
・Several other minor bug fixes

Also, as stated in the title, development of the "Rasen no Sora" will be suspended (frozen indefinitely)

Please refer to the progress video for the reason etc.
https://www.nicovideo.jp/watch/sm40209254

Thank you for your cooperation in the development of this title so far!
